title: Sample Means
body: Note that in this question, the empirical distribution of the sample mean is made up from the means of samples drawn from the population (not from resamples from a single sample). Assume that you have a certain population of interest whose histogram is below.\n##figure2.gif

figureAlts.figure2.gif: Histogram showing the distribution of a population. The x-axis is labeled Population, ranging from 0 to 8. The y-axis is labeled Percent per unit, ranging from 0 to 0.4. The histogram is right-skewed, with the highest bar near 0.4 at the lower end of the x-axis, and decreasing as the x-values increase.
